scripts.build: node node_modules/@omevision/release-guard/cli.mjs --phase source && vite build && node node_modules/@omevision/release-guard/cli.mjs --phase artifacts --path dist
scripts.deploy: npm run build && node node_modules/@omevision/release-guard/cli.mjs --phase deploy --path dist -- omevision-native-release --app google-cloud-build --check "omevision-blog-pages (hiyebo)" --target cloud-build/builds --branch master
scripts.deploy:artifact: node node_modules/@omevision/release-guard/cli.mjs --phase deploy --path dist -- omevision-native-release --app google-cloud-build --check "omevision-blog-pages (hiyebo)" --target cloud-build/builds --branch master
